verdict.rationale: Algolia has a live, probe-verified llms.txt (algolia-probe-1) and a docs.md index (algolia-probe-2) explicitly designed for agent consumption, plus a dedicated 'Build with AI' doc callout for agents (algolia-docs-57) and an agent-skills repo (algolia-docs-25, algolia-docs-17) referencing Algolia-specific docs/tools. This directly satisfies pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs with both first-party and probe corroboration. Missing for 10: no independent/community report of an agent successfully using llms.txt in practice.
